tasks.description: Independently review upload, atomic attachment and owner-only read of an optional first-aid observation photo.
constraints: Independent Reviewer and QA. Local gates only. Controller owns staging and checks weekly remaining usage.
Use the existing private byte verification, require owner and exact control binding, isolate from AI, preserve photo-free wire and replay, and check undo and expiry races.
Scope covers upload, ready confirmation, attachment and read. Deferred abandoned-upload cleanup and iOS UI. No invented schedule, migration 024 or StoreKit.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production entrypoints type-check and exact diff is clean.
HTTP and SQL prove ready and owner binding, immutable bytes, replay, private read, AI and quota isolation, and atomicity under undo and expiry races.
